text:
Aisha.NG: Quick ask — can we assemble a short customer-facing 90d playbook for onboarding that covers: ideal batching & cache defaults, streaming tradeoffs, renewal-risk signals, and AE handoff checklist? Need something we can share in onboarding call. TL;DR format. Thanks!

Tom.K: Yep. I'll sketch a compact version. Goal: one page + one config snippet customers can paste.

Priya.S: Engineering notes first — keep defaults conservative. Customers often use long prompts so we recommend: KV cache enabled, prefix caching for repeated system prompts, and batching sized to 10-20 concurrent tokens per GPU for latency-sensitive apps.

Tom.K: Draft config (customer-facing, safe defaults):
```json
{
  "batching": {
    "mode": "auto",
    "max_batch_size": "16",
    "target_latency_ms": "120"
  },
  "caching": {
    "kv_cache": "enabled",
    "prefix_cache_ttl_sec": "3600",
    "cache_scope": "account"
  },
  "streaming": {
    "enabled": "true",
    "chunk_size_tokens": "32"
  }
}
```
Short note: customers should tune max_batch_size down for <100ms SLOs and up for throughput jobs.

Maya.R: For AE handoff + renewal risk, propose a 5-point checklist we can attach: 
1) Account health dashboard connected (usage, latency, error rate)
2) Integration progress (sampler app working? docs completed?)
3) Cost delta from baseline (projected vs actual)
4) Support touchpoints/issues unresolved >3 days
5) Adoption signals (active users, embeddings per day)
Also flag renewal risk if: 30%+ drop in active users over 14 days OR sustained error rate >1% for 48h.

Evan.C: Add a simple customer script for the handoff call: 
- Intro + success metrics to date
- Show 2 dashboards: latency by route, token spend by model
- Share 90d checklist and ask for internal owners + dates
Suggested one-liner to set expectations: "We'll stabilize cost and latency in the first 30 days, then optimize quality/cost over the next 60."

Aisha.NG: Love these. Can we also add a short section on streaming vs batch trade-offs for customers who ask? Maybe a 3-line summary.

Priya.S: Sure — 3-line summary: 
- Streaming: lowest-first-byte latency, good for chat/interactive; slightly higher per-token CPU due to smaller chunking.
- Batch: better token efficiency and throughput for high-volume jobs (embedding generation, bulk reranks); higher tail latency.
- Hybrid: stream first N tokens then switch to batch for long generations. Works well for assistant + summarization flows.

Tom.K: I'll take the playbook and compress into a 1-pager + 1 JSON config. Will add call script and the renewal risk thresholds.

ops-bot: automation: onboarding-playbook-draft created by @tom.k — https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding-playbooks/1762003456

Aisha.NG: Awesome, please ping when draft is ready. Target: share with AE + Solutions by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

Maya.R: I'll prep the AE checklist card in Gainsight too once the doc is live.

Evan.C: Happy to run the first handoff with customer X next Tue to test the script.

Tom.K: Putting draft in the doc now — will ping here for reviews.

Aisha.NG: Thanks all — this will make onboarding calls so much smoother.
